intro: Flagongut's Fossil is an ancient specimen recovered from the dig sites of the Wetlands. Entrusted to the dwarven Explorers' League, it holds latent secrets that Archaeologist Flagongut seeks to decipher using a mysterious relic known as the Stone of Relu.

p: Unearthed as part of the dwarven expeditions across Khaz Modan, this ancient fossil represents more than just petrified stone. Archaeologist Flagongut believes it holds forgotten powers tied to the deep antiquity of the world, comparable to artifacts found across the sea in Darkshore. For safekeeping during regional studies, the fossil was held by Prospector Whelgar at his excavation site in the southern hills of the Wetlands.
